product: alt-context WP plugin public demo — [acx_demo_describe] anonymous describe widget
goals: Inventory OBSERVED public-demo states from the shipped shortcode and client: idle selection, queued, warming, describing, complete generic alt text, 429 limited, error/failed, and the 120-second poll ceiling (INT-10, RES-02, RES-03).

Keep PROPOSED typed CPU-fallback / GPU-final / unknown description-tier states out of the observed inventory. Producer DescriptionResultTier is provisional_cpu | final_gpu; the public adapter currently returns alt_text_draft only. Do not infer tier from gpu_state (HAI-05, HAI-08, PROV-06, DATA-13, rg-015).

Keep PROPOSED same-run resume bounded to the existing in-flight owner plus the in-memory idempotency key. Refresh drops that key. Do not invent a new paid job, do not raise the 120-second ceiling, and do not weaken authorization for terminal-run reads (API-02, API-04, RLSE-03).

jobs.label: Choose one operator-curated image and receive a generic alt-text draft
Retry the same in-page trigger without minting a new idempotency key

screens.title: Public demo › Describe an image
screens.purpose: OBSERVED visitor widget. Domain vocabulary behind canonical states: idle selection = default; queued, warming and describing = loading; no allowlisted images is a different screen; 429 limited = degraded; failed, invalid response, incomplete result and 120s poll timeout = error. Complete shows generic alt text with no description tier. Serves job describe-allowlisted-image.

zones.label: OBSERVED image picker — idle radios are instance-scoped (acx-demo-media-N) and read from the submitting form only. Empty-selection submit stays on this screen as error copy. No images is public-demo-unavailable, not this zone.
OBSERVED primary Describe selected image — enabled in idle, completed, failed, limited and timeout; disabled in in_flight. Same control retries; key reuse is in-memory only.

OBSERVED polite status — idle, queued, warming, describing, completed, limited (HTTP 429), failed, client error, 120s poll timeout. Icon plus token color. Envelope gpu_state is accepted and unused; it is lifecycle telemetry, not DescriptionResultTier.

OBSERVED completed result is generic alt_text_draft with focus move. Producer tiers provisional_cpu and final_gpu are dropped by the public adapter. PROPOSED CPU-fallback / GPU-final / unknown-tier presentation is absent and must not be inferred from gpu_state.

screens.title: Public demo › Unavailable
screens.purpose: OBSERVED PHP shortcode substitutes when the widget cannot run. Demo flag off = degraded limited copy. Allowlist empty or unreadable = error copy. No form, no client, no paid dispatch. Serves neither job until an operator enables the demo and curates media.

zones.label: OBSERVED substitute status — limited when the demo is disabled; error when no demo images are available. Not a describe-run phase.

screens.title: Refresh page (drops in-memory retry key)
screens.purpose: OBSERVED: a full page load drops the in-memory idempotency key and the in-memory run_id. Timeout copy currently tells the visitor to refresh. PROPOSED durable resume is not this exit and is not implemented.

zones.label: OBSERVED refresh consequence — in-memory retry key is gone. Same-page retry would have retained it. Do not claim a new paid job is proven or disproven after refresh.

open_questions: PROPOSED, not implemented: should the public complete state show typed description tier (CPU fallback / GPU final / unknown) from item.tier, never from gpu_state? Producer DescriptionResultTier is provisional_cpu | final_gpu only; unknown would be an explicit public absence token, not a guessed gpu_state.

PROPOSED, not implemented: same-run resume after refresh or after the 120s poll ceiling. Bound remains existing inflight owner + idempotency; not a new paid job; 120s per-poll ceiling stays; bulkhead and nonce/allowlist stay.

Design question, not a slice: how can a visitor securely re-read a terminal run after inflight is released (status today returns 403 run_not_available) without weakening authorization? A durable handle must not become an unauthenticated run oracle.
not_doing: Do not treat this map as the admin describe-gpu-tier map. Admin GPU chip, provisional/final badges, and gpu_state presentation are operator SPA, not public demo.
Do not infer CPU-fallback, GPU-final, or unknown description-tier UI from envelope gpu_state. That field is optional lifecycle telemetry and is unused by statusPresentation.
Do not claim refresh-safe resume is implemented. Refresh drops the in-memory retry key and run_id.
Do not claim same-page retry already proven to create duplicate paid jobs. Same-page retry reuses the key; duplicate-dispatch behaviour after refresh is not claimed here.
Do not raise the public 120-second poll ceiling to the server warmup-plus-inference deadline.
Do not add a new paid job, upload field, or URL input to resume or retry.
Do not weaken public status authorization to read arbitrary run_ids after inflight release.
slices: PROPOSED follow-up, not this map: optional item.tier wire through public_description (provisional_cpu | final_gpu, plus an explicit unknown when absent). Do not derive from gpu_state.
PROPOSED follow-up, not this map: same-run resume using existing owner plus idempotency only. Keep the 120s ceiling, inflight bulkhead, nonce, and allowlist.
Design-question follow-up, not this map: secure durable handle for terminal-run read after inflight release. No authorization weakening.
